# Rockhampton Pest Quotes

> Pest control and termite inspection quotes in Rockhampton, Gracemere, Norman Gardens, Parkhurst, Frenchville and Mount Morgan. A free referral service: one licensed local operator quotes for your job.

Rockhampton Pest Quotes (rockhamptonpestcontrol.com) is a free pest control referral service, not a pest control company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, pest type, property type, then contact details) and the request goes to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.

- Service: pest control, termite inspection and treatment, and pre-purchase timber pest inspection quotes
- Area: Rockhampton, Rockhampton Regional Council (QLD), including Rockhampton City, Allenstown, Wandal, West Rockhampton, The Range, Depot Hill, Park Avenue, Berserker, Frenchville, Koongal, Lakes Creek, Kawana, Norman Gardens, Parkhurst, Gracemere, Bouldercombe, Alton Downs, Mount Morgan
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job
- Licensing: In Queensland, pest management technicians need a pest management licence from Queensland Health under the Medicines and Poisons Act 2019. The licence lists what the holder is authorised to do, such as urban pests or timber pests. Chemical termite work also needs a Termite Management—Chemical licence from the QBCC.

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Rockhampton Pest Quotes cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take pest control quote requests from Rockhampton and nearby areas, including Rockhampton City, Allenstown, Wandal, West Rockhampton, The Range, Depot Hill, Park Avenue, Berserker, Frenchville, Koongal, Lakes Creek, Kawana, Norman Gardens, Parkhurst, Gracemere, Bouldercombe, Alton Downs, Mount Morgan. Our referral service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. Ask the operator whether they charge for travel to rural properties.
- **Does a pest controller need a licence?** In Queensland, pest management technicians need a pest management licence from Queensland Health under the Medicines and Poisons Act 2019. The licence lists what the holder is authorised to do, such as urban pests or timber pests. Chemical termite work also needs a Termite Management—Chemical licence from the QBCC.
- **What affects the price of pest control?** The pest, how widespread it is, the size and construction of the building, roof and subfloor access, and the treatment method. Termite work also depends on whether you need an inspection, a barrier, baiting or treatment of active termites. We don't publish prices. A local operator will quote for your job.
- **Who does the work?** Rockhampton Pest Quotes is a free referral service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't carry out pest control. We pass your request to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.
